strings.subtitle: — File destroyer —
strings.dnd_hint: (or drag a file intae this windae)
strings.dnd_unavailable: Draggin an drappin no available. Uise the button ablow.
strings.shred_button: D E S T R O Y
strings.ssd_warning:
Cawtion! On SSD, the owerscrievin method disna garantee destruction acause o TRIM.
This program is for HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
The file "{name}" will be owerscrieved an deletit.

Continue?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target fyle it pynts tae will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite disna guarantee destruction — the server may hae snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep auld blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS alternative data straims (ADS) arna processed.
• The USN journal isna cleired.
• Shadda copies an clood syncs
  (OneDrive etc.) arna affectit.
strings.status_full: Content fully owerscrieved wi zeros. Recovery impossible — tools will see zeros anely.
strings.status_fast: Heid, tail an 4 MB stripes owerscrieved. The lave is untouched, but acause o gaps, full recovery bi consumer tools is impossible. For confidential documents, uise FULL mode.
strings.status_empty: The file wis empie, owerscrievin no needit. Deletit.
strings.error_permission: Cannae access the fyle. It may be open in anither program. Close it an try again.
strings.error_not_found: Fyle not found. It may hae already been deleted.
strings.error_is_symlink: This is a symbolic link. Links cannae be destroyed — the target fyle will remain intact.
strings.error_reparse: This is a placeholder fyle (OneDrive or similar). Its data is stored in the cloud, not on disk — naethin tae destroy here.
strings.error_not_file: This is not a fyle (a folder or something else). Drop a fyle.
strings.error_hardlinks: This fyle haes ither hard links ({n} total). Hard links hae na primary — aw names are equal. If ye destroy via current path, the data will be overwritten an truncated tae 32 bytes, but the stub will remain accessible via ither links. Delete aw links first.
strings.error_compressed:
Fyle is compressed, encrypted or sparse. Zero overwrite disna guarantee destruction o auld data because NTFS stores it differently.

Remove the attribute: richt-click → Properties → Advanced → uncheck 'Compress' an/or 'Encrypt'. Then run SHREDDER again.
strings.queue_confirm_text:
{count} fyles will be destroyed.
Total size: {size}.

Check the list before continuing.
This action is irreversible.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Remove aw {count} fyles frae the queue?

The fyles themselves will NOT be touched — only the list.
strings.hardlink_text:
Fyle "{name}" haes ither hard links ({nlink} total).

Data will be destroyed for aw names.
But stubs (32 bytes) will remain unner ither names in the folder.

You may need tae delete these stubs manually.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Apply tae aw hard links in queue
